title: After School Dice Club
description: A story about girls playing board games after school!Kyoto in Spring. Aya is a high school girl who’s just moved to a new town. Miki is her shy classmate, and her first friend. One day after school Aya and Miki follow the committee president Midori to a speciality board games store. The Dice Club!! Without thinking they try out a German board game together.These girls, who are searching for fun, soon fall into the exciting world of games!

episodes_data.title: After School Dice Club Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Miki, a high school student born and raised in Kyoto, knows very little about how to have fun. Her classmate Aya seeks to change this, with the reluctant help of another classmate, Midori.

episodes_data.title: After School Dice Club Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: After their encounter, the three girls, Miki, Aya and Midori, have become fast friends. Excited to step into the new world of board games, Miki and Aya implore Midori to intoduce them to more games.

episodes_data.title: After School Dice Club Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Miki, Aya and Midori gather at Aya's house to play board games. They are joined by Hana, Aya's sister, and Maki, Hana's friend. Miki feels like she has met Maki before somewhere, but can't quite remember.

episodes_data.title: After School Dice Club Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Student council vice-chair Ren wants to bring Midori into the student council, but Midori declines, saying she has other priorities. Ren follows Midori to her workplace after school to find out what it is Midori is so passionate about.

episodes_data.title: After School Dice Club Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Summer break has started, so Miki, Aya and Midori decide to go on a trip together. They visit Miki's aunt's inn in Kanazawa, and discover a classic Japanese game, GOITA.

episodes_data.title: After School Dice Club Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Midori meets George, a famous game designer from the USA. He gives her some harsh advice on the game she is making, which Miki interprets as a challenge.

episodes_data.title: After School Dice Club Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Maki finds Miki without anything to do, so they decide to hang out for the day. Meanwhile, as the school festival gets closer, students plan various events to spice up the festival.

episodes_data.title: After School Dice Club Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: The three girls visit a new board game café that opened up near their school. There, they meet Emilia, another board game fanatic around the same age as them, who moved to Kyoto recently from Germany.

episodes_data.title: After School Dice Club Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Emilia's dream is to become a game designer. She wants to discuss this with Midori, who shares the same dream, but Midori is afraid that she would be simply inferior to Emilia.

episodes_data.title: After School Dice Club Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Aya's father Kenji comes home to Japan, just in time for Christmas. However, he seems to be more excited about his work than seeing his daughters.

episodes_data.title: After School Dice Club Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: George, the famous American professional game designer, invites Midori to submit his game to his company's game design competition. Midori, with the help of her friends, feels ready to take on the challenge.

episodes_data.title: After School Dice Club Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Midori and Emilia discuss their ambitions and lay out detailed plans to achieve them. Aya is full of dreams and aspirations. Miki, however, just wants everything to stay the same.
